data.name: Zelina
data.gender_notes: Zelina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Zelina comes from the Hebrew word 'zela', meaning 'shadow, concealment, or treasure'. In the Bible, this name is borne by Zelina, the wife of King Saul in 1 Samuel 14:50. The name is also believed to be derived from the Greek word 'zelos', meaning 'zeal' or 'zealousness'. In Christian tradition, Zelina represents a hidden treasure given by God and symbolizes the spiritual richness and depth that can be found in the faith.
data.etymology: Zelina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's hidden treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zelina total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: צְלִינָה
in_hebrew.meaning: צְלִינָה: שם נשי, מקורו בעברית, פירושו: צל נשימה, עורפי, ישר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: צְלִינָה: שם נשי המופיע באנגלית, ומקורו בעברית. השם נבחר על פי הפירוש שלו, "צל" - סמל של עורפיות, "נשימה" - סמל של חיים, ו"ישר" - סמל של ישרות. על פי הספרות העברית, השם צְלִינָה מציין אדם שיש לו חיים נשימים, ושהוא מלא ישרות ועורפיות. השם נמצא בשימוש בקהילות יהודיות, וגם בקהילות נוצריות, בעיקר בשם נשים.

in_greek.name: Ζελίνα
in_greek.meaning: Ζελίνα: θηλυκό όνομα, από το εβραϊκό, σημαίνει: σκιερό, φυσικό, ανοιχτό
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζελίνα: θηλυκό όνομα που προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό και σημαίνει σκιερό, φυσικό, ανοιχτό. Το όνομα Ζελίνα είναι δημοφιλές στην Ελλάδα και έχει μια πλούσια ιστορία. Ονομάστηκε έτσι επειδή το παιδί που έχει το όνομα αυτό είναι σαν σκιερό, φυσικό παιδί. Είναι ανοιχτό και φιλόξενο, και οι γονείς του το δίνουν επειδή θέλουν να τον προστατεύσουν. Ονομάστηκε έτσι επειδή το παιδί που έχει το όνομα Ζελίνα είναι σαν σκιερό, φυσικό παιδί. Είναι ανοιχτό και φιλόξενο.

in_latin.name: Zelina
in_latin.meaning: Zelina: nomen femininum, ex Hebraeo, significat: umbratile, naturale, apertum
in_latin.long_meaning: Zelina: nomen femininum quod a Hebraeo ortum est, significat umbratile, naturale, apertum. Nomen Zelina in usu est in Ecclesia Catholica et in cultura Christiana, et significat quod persona qui hunc nomen habet est umbratile, naturale, et apertum. Hoc nomen in usu est in familia Christiana et significat quod persona qui hunc nomen habet est filius Dei, et est apertus ad verbum Dei.

historical_references.reference: Zelina of Zadar was a popular Christian saint and martyr from Dalmatia, Croatia. She is said to have been the daughter of a pagan priest, who converted to Christianity after seeing her miraculous healing of his blindness. Her father subsequently killed Zelina and her mother, then he was struck blind again before being converted by his Christian slave. Zelina's feast day is celebrated on October 22.

Another Zelina, also known as Saint Helena of Stridon, was a Frankish queen and mother of Charlemagne. She is said to have made a pilgrimage to the Holy Land in the late 8th century to find the True Cross of Christ. Her relics were later transferred to the Abbey of Prémontré in Belgium, where her feast day is celebrated on May 27.
